title: Conclude a ceiling-reached test with no detected difference as no winner
body:
## Summary
evaluateTestWithBasis crowns a winner when the trial ceiling is reached even at band none.

## Description
src/lib/prompt-evolution/ab-testing.ts:145 concludes on `confidence >= 0.8 || totalTrials >= minTrials * 4` and always sets winnerId via decideWinner. The technique min-trials-and-confidence-banded-conclusion says reaching the ceiling is a legitimate result of "no difference detected at this sample size", and band none is reported as such. Fixed: ceiling at band none concludes with winnerId null and adoption reads no-winner. Outside this round's file list (lib/prompt-evolution).

## Flow
- Both arms reach 20 trials with 50% vs 55%
- z is below 1.28, totalTrials hits the ceiling
- decideWinner crowns one arm by rate or duration
- Test card headlines "X wins"; adoption is offered with the new caution only

## Expected impact
Operators stop adopting coin flips as winners. getBestVariant, suggestions and StatsBadge wins would all see fewer crowns; existing concluded rows stay as they are.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a no-difference result is stored and shown as one
Before: 1 path crowns at band none (ab-testing.ts:145), confirmed by reading
After: predicted 0 crowns at band none past the ceiling
Method: simulation - three walked cases (50 vs 55 percent at 20 trials, tie by duration, 0 vs 0 percent); no DB fixture run in this round
Result: better
Gate: contract
instrument: A vitest case on evaluateTestWithBasis at the ceiling asserting winnerId null at band none, plus getBestVariant and suggestion consumers green

title: State band none and weak in the plain-language headline
body:
## Summary
explainTestVerdict headlines "X wins" and explains "finished successfully more often" whatever the band.

## Description
src/lib/prompt-evolution/plain-language.ts builds the headline from concluded alone and `why` from the rate gap, never reading verdict.band. The golden path: "the failure mode is the small sample reported with the language of a large one". Fixed: weak headlines "X leads", none headlines "No clear difference (picked X)". Outside this round's file list.

## Flow
- A test concludes at 3 trials per arm by decide-now
- Banner headline reads "B wins"
- Only the small confidence note hints otherwise

## Expected impact
Simple Mode users read the strength of a result in its headline. plain-language tests pin current wording and need updating.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - headline matches the band
Before: 0 of 4 bands change the concluded headline
After: predicted 2 of 4 (weak, none) change it
Method: simulation - plain-language.ts read and three verdict shapes walked; the file is outside this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Hold running-test leads back until both arms clear the floor
body:
## Summary
A running test says "X is ahead" from two total trials, below the per-arm floor.

## Description
plain-language.ts returns "Too early to call" only for totalTrials < 2 or a tie. A 1 vs 1 split with one success already headlines a leader, while the card beside it says the test needs more runs. Fixed: use verdict.shortfall so any unmet floor reads "Too early to call". Outside this round's file list.

## Flow
- Serve A once (success) and B once (failure)
- Banner: "A is ahead"
- Same card: "Needs 2 more runs of A and 2 more runs of B"

## Expected impact
The two statements on one card agree. One existing explainTestVerdict case may pin the old threshold.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one floor for leader claims
Before: leader claimed at 2 total trials; floor is 3 per arm (6 total)
After: predicted no leader below 3 per arm
Method: simulation - 1v1, 3v1 and 3v3 walked against plain-language.ts
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: explainTestVerdict cases at 1v1 and 3v1 asserting "Too early to call"

title: Count judged trials toward the decide-now floor when judges exist
body:
## Summary
The manual floor counts serves, so unjudged runs satisfy it.

## Description
forceConclude (src/lib/prompt-evolution/ab-testing.ts:180) checks variantATrials and variantBTrials only. The technique step 4: "Compute the band on judged trials only. Unjudged trials do not count toward the minimum." With zero verdicts the decision falls back to self-reported completion flags. Fixed: where the project judges this item, require the judged floor, or label the conclusion self-reported at the refusal point.

## Flow
- Serve each arm 3 times with no verdicts
- Decide-now succeeds on self-reported flags
- Winner carries the self-reported basis only

## Expected impact
Fewer decide-now crowns on unjudged evidence. Items with no judging path need an explicit fallback so they are not locked out.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the floor measures evidence, not serves
Before: 0 judged verdicts satisfy the floor
After: predicted a floor of 3 verdicts per arm where judging exists
Method: simulation - forceConclude read and three cases walked; product decision on unjudged items remains
Result: better
Gate: contract
evidence: src/lib/prompt-evolution/ab-testing.ts:180-185 shortfall from variantATrials/variantBTrials; verdict.ts:25 MIN_TRIALS_PER_VARIANT comment "SERVED"
instrument: forceConclude cases with and without JudgeScores

title: Scope A/B judge scores to the verdicts earned during the test
body:
## Summary
Judged arm rates use every verdict a variant ever earned, not those from this test.

## Description
judgeScoresByVariant (src/lib/prompt-evolution/engine.ts:327) aggregates per variant with no test window. A variant reused in a second test brings its earlier verdicts, so the arms are compared over different periods, which the technique forbids ("Hold the input set constant across arms"; "Interleave trials"). Fixed: restrict by the test window (createdAt to concludedAt) or by a trial id on the artifact.

## Flow
- Variant B wins a test and collects 20 verdicts
- B is challenged by new variant C
- B enters with 20 old verdicts, C with 3 new ones

## Expected impact
The judged basis measures the experiment rather than history. Needs an artifact-to-test join that may not exist yet.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - judged arms share one window
Before: 1 aggregation with no time or test bound
After: predicted verdicts bounded to the test window
Method: simulation - engine.ts:327 read; no DB fixture built; a join decision is needed first
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: contract
instrument: A fixture with old and in-window verdicts asserting only in-window ones count

title: Stop reporting sub-band scores as winner confidence in suggestions
body:
## Summary
Adopt suggestions state "won with 70% confidence" for a decide-now volume score.

## Description
generateSuggestions (src/lib/prompt-evolution/engine.ts:552) prints Math.round(test.confidence * 100) and SuggestionsBar renders it as a Target badge. Below 0.8 the stored number is z/2 or min(0.7, n/20), not a confidence. ABTestCard now refuses this reading; the engine message and the badge do not. Fixed: word it by band ("decided below the weakest band") and hide the badge below 0.8.

## Flow
- Decide-now at 7 trials per arm gives 0.7
- Suggestion reads "won with 70% confidence"
- Test card says no significance result

## Expected impact
Suggestion and card agree. Tests that pin the message need updating.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one reading of stored confidence
Before: 2 surfaces disagree after this round (card fixed, suggestion not)
After: predicted 0 disagree
Method: simulation - engine.ts:552 and SuggestionsBar read, one decide-now case walked; engine.ts is outside this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Rebuild Avg Improvement from winner-versus-loser per test with a floor
body:
## Summary
Stats "Avg Improvement" subtracts maxima taken across different tests with no trial floor.

## Description
getEvolutionStats (src/lib/prompt-evolution/engine.ts:605-613) sets bestRate to the max of any arm and defaultRate to the max of the lower arms, across all concluded tests, on self-reported rates, with no floor. A single 3-vs-3 test can produce +100%. StatsPanel shows it as a KPI and picks "Top performing module" from it. The golden path says this scale of data cannot support "6% better". Fixed: average winner minus loser per test above a floor, on the verdict basis, and show n.

## Flow
- Conclude one test at 3/3 vs 0/3
- bestRate 1, defaultRate 0
- Stats shows +100% and that module as top performer

## Expected impact
The headline KPI stops overstating. The figure will drop for existing data.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the KPI is a per-test difference with a floor
Before: 1 cross-test max subtraction with 0 floor
After: predicted per-test mean over tests above the floor
Method: simulation - engine.ts:605-613 read and two datasets walked; engine.ts is outside this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: getEvolutionStats cases: one 3v3 test, and two tests with disjoint rates

title: Replace the fixed optimizer uplift table or validate it against outcomes
body:
## Summary
estimateImprovement sums fixed constants per diff type, capped at 50%.

## Description
src/lib/prompt-evolution/engine.ts:850-886 adds per-type constants (0.08, 0.12, 0.06 and so on) and returns up to 0.5, independent of outcomes except for add-context. This round relabelled the UI as a rule-of-thumb estimate; the number itself remains unmeasured. Distinct from the recorded prompt-assembly deviation at OptimizerPanel.tsx:125, which is about shortening deleting conditionals. Fixed: back-test against concluded optimizer challengers, or drop the number.

## Flow
- Optimize any prompt with no session history
- Diff types sum to a percentage
- Panel and ring show it

## Expected impact
Removes an unmeasured percentage from a decision surface.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the uplift figure is measured or absent
Before: 6 constant uplifts, cap 0.5
After: predicted a back-tested figure or none
Method: simulation - engine.ts read; needs concluded optimizer challengers which were not sampled
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: Back-test script over concluded tests whose challenger origin is the optimizer
